prerequisites: Official immutable provider release identity verified; no workspace link or local tarball substitution
Approved adoption configuration committed on a separate source epoch
Node v24.20.0; installed package migrations and doctor pass
Unchanged input roots, seven original task descriptors, thresholds and N/A; C6 producers inactive
measurement_sequence: Generate prerequisite inventory, build, migration, original complete tests/coverage and approved performance artifacts using declared role and supported command. Keep C6 native service producers inactive.

Execute canonical first pass excluding task-backed and regeneration sensors; execute those separately under their registered role and local-write effect. Include all five repaired static sensors with unchanged declared populations.

For EACH emission: capture raw envelope, validate against installed schema, verify frozen source/input/provider identity, immediately sense record as Inspector before any next sensor. If record fails stop; preserve the attempt and do not recollect into the same lineage.
Run and immediately record second-pass store readers harness_invariant_alignment and inventory_performance; record unsupported or missing evidence as gaps without activating C6.
Run audit scorecard --repo-root . --at <new-40-character-frozen-sha> --format json; reconcile exactly 45 unique coordinates: 43 applicable plus existing F1:T1 and F4:T5 N/A.
Verify evidence chain and all preservation hashes. Report fresh measured count separately from verdict counts and blockers; keep earlier assessment and product backlog untouched.

canonical_command_templates.run: pnpm exec devai sense run <sensor> --repo-root . --round R-0042 --input <unchanged-declared-input-json> --format json
canonical_command_templates.record: pnpm exec devai sense record --repo-root . --input <exact-emitted-reading-file> --as-role inspector --write --format json
canonical_command_templates.chain: pnpm exec devai evidence verify --scope chain --repo-root . --show-head --format human

stop_conditions: Any threshold, input population, N/A, closed-round or historical proof change
Any C6 producer activation or native custody claim without separate security disposition
Missing official package identity, independent review, release authority, rehearsal or mandatory check
Stale input/report, interrupted command, schema mismatch, failed persistence or ambiguous reading lineage
